name: brutalist_agency
market: Global, design and tech industry clients, luxury and challenger brands
density: Deliberately jarring. Elements don't align to a comfortable grid — they purposefully collide, overlap, and contrast. Heavy black borders. Large raw typography at extreme sizes. Case study images break out of their containers. The chaos IS the design statement.
nav_style: The nav is part of the design statement. Oversized monospace numbers count the pages. Navigation is a fixed left column with thick black border containing the agency name vertically oriented. Or: a full-screen overlay nav triggered by a minimal icon. Everything is unexpected.
commercial_model: Agency business model. Revenue from project work. No pricing listed — 'Talk to us' CTA. Emphasis on prestigious clients and awards. Case studies are the product.
color_palette: Stark black (#000000) and white (#FFFFFF) as dominant pair. Then ONE electric accent color that changes per project: might be yellow (#FFE500), red (#FF1A1A), or cyan (#00FFFF). Extreme contrast ratios, no mid-tones. The monochrome base plus one screaming accent is the signature brutalist palette.
typography: Brutalist type is the main visual element. Giant serif for contrast (Freight Display or similar at 120-200px). Condensed grotesque for functional text. Monospace for project numbers and technical metadata. Text overlaps images. Text is used decoratively at extreme scales.

pages.title: Home
pages.description: Full-bleed black background. Agency name in massive 200px white type. One-line manifesto. Three featured case study previews with overlapping images and number labels. Horizontal scrolling or dramatic full-screen sections.

pages.title: Work
pages.description: Case studies grid in brutalist layout — different sizes, some full-bleed, some small. Project names overlap images. Client name, year, type label. Hover reveals full project title over black overlay.

pages.title: Case Study
pages.description: Single project case study. Brand name huge. Full-bleed hero image. Project brief text at large scale. Process photos in irregular layout. Results metrics displayed large. Related work at bottom.

pages.title: Studio
pages.description: About page as manifesto. Large text statements. Team photos in asymmetric layout with overlaid names. Client logo list as compact grid. Office location in very large type. Awards ticker.

pages.title: Contact
pages.description: Minimal contact page that's a design statement itself. Single email address at 80px. Business address in small type. New business form that's deliberately minimal. Social links as plain text.
